Thanks Lucy & Tom  great conversation earlier today. Quick recap and proposed POC plan so we have alignment:

Recap (what we heard)
- Goal: improve triage routing and patient message classification across English, Spanish, and French.
- Volume target: ~10k messages/day initially; p95 latency target <400ms for interactive review flows.
- Data sensitivity: some PHI in messages; Acme prefers customer-managed keys and audit logs.

Proposed 4-week POC (high level)
1) Week 0 (prep): data sample exchange, access, and compliance review (KMS/HSM questions).
2) Week 1: ingest sample data, run baseline evaluation.
3) Week 2-3: model tuning/temperature/profile testing + human eval.
4) Week 4: final evaluation, handoff + recommendations.

Success criteria (to validate at end of trial)
- Automation rate increase: precision for routing intents >= 88% on held-out test set.
- Latency: median <250ms; p95 <400ms in Redwood hosted environment (or Dedicated if requested).
- Safety/privacy: no PHI persisted in hosted logs unless using Private with KMS.
- Human eval: >= 90% intent-match agreement on 200 sampled cases.

Model selection (initial recommendation)
- Primary candidate: Mistral-instruct-7B (strong instruction-following, good cost/latency tradeoff).
- Fallback: Llama-2-7b-chat quantized (int8) for lower-latency cheap path in burst scenarios.
- Multilingual: if Spanish/French quality is a requirement, we can test Llama-2-13b-chat as a variant; we recommend including a small bilingual eval set.

Next steps / asks for Acme
- Confirm ability to share a de-identified sample dataset (or sign a DPA for PHI).
- Confirm POC start week (we proposed week of 2026-08-16).
- Any other stakeholders to loop in (security/compliance contact).

Attached: ACME_POC_Mutual_ACTION_Plan.pdf and a sample prompt set (CSV).

Ben

Hi Lucy  thanks for the notes. Quick technical plan and answers to your asks:

Security/compliance:
- We can provide SOC 2 type II report and a redacted architecture diagram. For PHI, we recommend using Redwood Private (VPC) or Dedicated with customer-managed KMS; both options offer audit logs and no customer data retention by default. I will attach the security checklist in a follow-up (we have a templated spreadsheet for InfoSec).

Model selection rationale and evaluation plan:
- Start with Mistral-instruct-7B as the primary model for the trial due to its instruction-following and token efficiency.
- Parallel evaluation: run Llama-2-13b-chat on the bilingual test subset (Spanish) to compare quality. If Mistral falls below our Spanish threshold, we will recommend switching to the 13B variant for the Spanish pipeline.
- Fallback model: Llama-2-7b-chat quantized (int8) for latency-sensitive flows; will only be used if cost/latency requirements force a tradeoff.

Evaluation details:
- Dataset split: 70/15/15 (train/dev/test) from the de-identified sample.
- Metrics: label-level precision/recall/F1 for routing intents; macro-averaged F1 target >= 0.88.
- Human eval: 200 sampled messages reviewed by Acme SMEs; we measure intent-match rate (>=90%).
- Latency tests: run synthetic load to estimate median/p95 in your target infra (hosted vs dedicated).

Ownership & timeline:
- Sales owner: Ben Carter (day-to-day commercial).
- SE/technical owner: Marissa Cole (POC lead).
- Compliance/contract: Redwood legal will provide SOW/PO template and DPA addendum; Ben will coordinate.
- Proposed kickoff: Mon 2026-08-16  data exchange and security checklist completed by Fri 2026-08-13.
